title: Coglianese: Dimensions of Delegation
summary: Coglianese proposes measuring delegated power along multiple dimensions to explain why Schechter can coexist with later permissive decisions.
notes:
The assigned excerpt argues that the breadth of regulated activities and targets matters alongside the precision of decisional criteria. The National Industrial Recovery Act allowed regulation of nearly every aspect of economic conduct across industries. The Clean Air Act’s air-pollution program had enormous consequences but a more bounded legal subject.

Coglianese acknowledges that Panama Refining, which concerned interstate oil transport, resists this explanation. He regards that anomaly as weaker evidence against the dimensional account than the larger pattern supporting it. This is a scholarly synthesis, offered as an alternative to declaring the doctrine dead or treating many later cases as mistaken.
